CREATE VIEW [InternationalLogistics].[vw_CUS__ShipmentEmissions] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
WITH ShipmentTransport AS ( SELECT JobShipment.ShipmentKey, Transport.ConsolAndShipmentTransportKey, NULL AS ConsolidationKey, NULL AS ConsolidationShipmentPivotKey, Transport.ATD, Transport.ATA, Transport.JobSailingKey, Transport.CarrierAddressKey, Transport.IsLinked, Transport.TransportMode FROM [InternationalLogistics].[BAS__Shipment] AS JobShipment JOIN [InternationalLogistics].[BAS__ConsolAndShipmentTransport] AS Transport ON JobShipment.ShipmentKey = Transport.ShipmentKey
UNION ALL
SELECT JobShipment.ShipmentKey, Transport.ConsolAndShipmentTransportKey, JobConsol.ConsolidationKey, ConShipLink.ConsolidationShipmentPivotKey, Transport.ATD, Transport.ATA, Transport.JobSailingKey, Transport.CarrierAddressKey, Transport.IsLinked, Transport.TransportMode FROM [InternationalLogistics].[BAS__Shipment] AS JobShipment JOIN [InternationalLogistics].[BAS__ConsolidationShipmentPivot] AS ConShipLink ON ConShipLink.ShipmentKey = JobShipment.ShipmentKey JOIN [InternationalLogistics].[BAS__Consolidation] AS JobConsol ON JobConsol.ConsolidationKey = ConShipLink.ConsolidationKey JOIN [InternationalLogistics].[BAS__ConsolAndShipmentTransport] AS Transport ON JobConsol.ConsolidationKey = Transport.ConsolidationKey ) SELECT [ActualArrivalDate] = MAX(Transport.ATA) OVER (PARTITION BY JobShipment.ShipmentKey), [ActualDepartureDate] = MIN(Transport.ATD) OVER (PARTITION BY JobShipment.ShipmentKey), [ArrivalDate] = JobShipment.ArrivalDate, [CarrierAddressKey] = CarrierAddr.OrganizationAddressKey, [CarrierOrgCode] = CarrierOrg.Code, [CarrierOrgID] = CarrierOrg.OrganizationID, [CO2eStatus] = JobCO2e.CO2eStatus, [ConsigneeAddressKey] = ConsigneeDocAddr.ConsigneeAddressKey, [ConsigneeOrgAddressKey] = ConsigneeAddr.OrganizationAddressKey, [ConsigneeOrgCode] = ConsigneeOrg.Code, [ConsigneeOrgID] = ConsigneeOrg.OrganizationID, [ConsignorAddressKey] = ConsignorDocAddr.ConsignorAddressKey, [ConsignorOrgAddressKey] = ConsignorAddr.OrganizationAddressKey, [ConsignorOrgCode] = ConsignorOrg.Code, [ConsignorOrgID] = ConsignorOrg.OrganizationID, [ConsolAndShipmentTransportKey] = Transport.ConsolAndShipmentTransportKey, [ConsolidationKey] = Transport.ConsolidationKey, [ConsolidationShipmentPivotKey] = Transport.ConsolidationShipmentPivotKey, [ControllingCustomerAddressKey] = ControllingCustomerDocAddr.ControllingCustomerAddressKey, [ControllingCustomerOrgAddressKey] = ControllingCustomerAddr.OrganizationAddressKey, [ControllingCustomerOrgCode] = ControllingCustomerOrg.Code, [ControllingCustomerOrgID] = ControllingCustomerOrg.OrganizationID, [DepartureDate] = JobShipment.DepartureDate, [DistanceInKM] = JobCO2e.Distance, [HouseBillNumber] = JobShipment.HouseBillNumber, [JobHeaderKey] = JobHeader.JobHeaderKey, [JobNumber] = JobShipment.JobNumber, [JobSailingKey] = Sailing.JobSailingKey, [JobVoyageKey] = Voyage.JobVoyageKey, [JobVoyageOrganizationKey] = Voyage.OrganizationKey, [JobVoyOriginKey] = VoyOrigin.JobVoyOriginKey, [LocalClientAddressKey] = LocalClientAddr.OrganizationAddressKey, [LocalClientOrgCode] = LocalClientOrg.Code, [LocalClientOrgID] = LocalClientOrg.OrganizationID, [PortOfDestination] = JobShipment.PortOfDestination, [PortOfOrigin] = JobShipment.PortOfOrigin, [ShipmentCO2eKey] = JobCO2e.ShipmentCO2eKey, [ShipmentKey] = JobShipment.ShipmentKey, [ShipmentUnitOfWeight] = JobShipment.UnitOfWeight, [ShipmentWeight] = JobShipment.ActualWeight, [SystemCreateTimeUtc] = JobShipment.SystemCreateTimeUtc, [TotalCO2e] = JobCO2e.TotalCO2e, [TransportMode] = JobShipment.TransportMode FROM [InternationalLogistics].[BAS__ShipmentCO2e] AS JobCO2e JOIN [InternationalLogistics].[BAS__Shipment] AS JobShipment ON JobCO2e.ShipmentKey = JobShipment.ShipmentKey LEFT JOIN [Finance].[BAS__JobHeader] AS JobHeader ON JobHeader.ShipmentKey = JobShipment.ShipmentKey LEFT JOIN [Organization].[BAS__OrganizationAddress] AS LocalClientAddr ON LocalClientAddr.OrganizationAddressKey = JobHeader.LocalAgentAddressKey LEFT JOIN [Organization].[BAS__Organization] AS LocalClientOrg ON LocalClientOrg.OrganizationKey = LocalClientAddr.OrganizationKey LEFT JOIN [InternationalLogistics].[BAS__ControllingCustomerAddress] AS ControllingCustomerDocAddr ON ControllingCustomerDocAddr.ShipmentKey = JobShipment.ShipmentKey LEFT JOIN [Organization].[BAS__OrganizationAddress] AS ControllingCustomerAddr ON ControllingCustomerAddr.OrganizationAddressKey = ControllingCustomerDocAddr.AddressKey LEFT JOIN [Organization].[BAS__Organization] AS ControllingCustomerOrg ON ControllingCustomerOrg.OrganizationKey = ControllingCustomerAddr.OrganizationKey LEFT JOIN [InternationalLogistics].[BAS__ConsigneeAddress] AS ConsigneeDocAddr ON ConsigneeDocAddr.ShipmentKey = JobShipment.ShipmentKey LEFT JOIN [Organization].[BAS__OrganizationAddress] AS ConsigneeAddr ON ConsigneeAddr.OrganizationAddressKey = ConsigneeDocAddr.AddressKey LEFT JOIN [Organization].[BAS__Organization] AS ConsigneeOrg ON ConsigneeOrg.OrganizationKey = ConsigneeAddr.OrganizationKey LEFT JOIN [InternationalLogistics].[BAS__ConsignorAddress] AS ConsignorDocAddr ON ConsignorDocAddr.ShipmentKey = JobShipment.ShipmentKey LEFT JOIN [Organization].[BAS__OrganizationAddress] AS ConsignorAddr ON ConsignorAddr.OrganizationAddressKey = ConsignorDocAddr.AddressKey LEFT JOIN [Organization].[BAS__Organization] AS ConsignorOrg ON ConsignorOrg.OrganizationKey = ConsignorAddr.OrganizationKey LEFT JOIN [ShipmentTransport] AS Transport ON Transport.ShipmentKey = JobShipment.ShipmentKey LEFT JOIN [Sailing].[BAS__JobSailing] AS Sailing ON Sailing.JobSailingKey = Transport.JobSailingKey LEFT JOIN [Sailing].[BAS__JobVoyOrigin] AS VoyOrigin ON VoyOrigin.JobVoyOriginKey = Sailing.JobVoyOriginKey LEFT JOIN [Sailing].[BAS__JobVoyage] AS Voyage ON Voyage.JobVoyageKey = VoyOrigin.JobVoyageKey LEFT JOIN [Organization].[BAS__OrganizationAddress] AS CarrierAddr ON CarrierAddr.OrganizationAddressKey = Transport.CarrierAddressKey LEFT JOIN [Organization].[BAS__Organization] AS CarrierOrg ON CarrierOrg.OrganizationKey = IIF(Transport.IsLinked = 1 and Transport.TransportMode = 'SEA', Voyage.OrganizationKey, CarrierAddr.OrganizationKey);
